name: Karina Macias
office: City of Huntington Park, Member of the City Council, 2nd District (Unexpired term ending December 8, 2028)

items.text: Karina Macias has been a Huntington Park City Council member since 2013. She was mayor for the 2015-2016 term. She again served as mayor in 2025. She holds a master’s degree in international studies from Chapman University and previously worked as an Assistant Justice Coordinator for the Sisters of St. Joseph.
